job: Fill in a long form in sections and register something, with every problem named next to its field.
purpose: A sectioned form for one create action: label and description on the left, fields on the right. It mixes text, choices, tag lists, key and value pairs, switches and a JSON field. Validation runs on blur and on submit and fills each field error. A refused submit shows a banner above the form and the field it concerns; submitting holds the form still behind a busy button.
useWhen: One create or edit action needs many grouped settings and the person reviews them before saving.
Errors must say what to change in the field, not in a toast.

avoidWhen.when: The form edits something that exists and shows a save bar only when changed.
The form is the first run of a new account in steps.
